title: Settings page
description: Section nav, profile form, settings rows with one control each, grouped sub-settings, danger zone

quality.settingRow: One Setting per control — label and description left, control right. A list of Settings needs no surface around it
quality.grouping: SettingGroup with a header control and open={enabled}, so sub-settings sit inside its box; SettingAxes for X/Y pairs
quality.explainers: info on a Setting (an InfoTip) instead of a description line that is only needed once
quality.forms: Profile fields in a Form (columns per breakpoint), not hand-spaced Columns
